scientific_integrity: A sharp completed-step entrywise nonnegativity result, verified analytically through an orthogonal spectral resolution and checked on finite exact-rational examples. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only homogeneous weighted clique blades K_1 join r K_s with r,s>=2 and a,b>0; no statement for arbitrary weights, other timesteppers, nonconstant mass matrices, or PDE discretization accuracy. A general resolvent positivity criterion and other classic theta-method results predate this work. Indexed-search noncoverage does not establish universal originality.
title: A sharp spoke-to-blade positivity transition for Crank–Nicolson diffusion on generalized windmills
